values.note: Campsites are first-come, first-served: register at forest headquarters (open 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily) or at the outdoor self-registration kiosk when the office is closed, cash or check only. Groups of 20 or more can reserve a group site by calling headquarters.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Documents/greenridge/GRSF_VisitorsGuide-Map.pdf ('Campsites are first-come, first-serve. Register at forest headquarters upon arrival. For groups of 20 or more, reserved camping is available for group sites by calling forest headquarters at 301-478-3124.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/western_greenridgeforest.aspx ('7 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily. Self-registration is available at the outdoor kiosk when the office is closed for camping, shooting range, and fuelwood permits. Cash or check only.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Standard site $10 per night; group site $20 per night.

fees.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/Greenridge/recreation-trails.aspx ('Standard site: $10 per night  Group site: $20 per night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: 'approximately 100 primitive campsites distributed throughout the forest', each with a picnic table and fire ring, plus three group sites. DNR gives no site lengths or RV guidance.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/Greenridge/recreation-trails.aspx ('Green Ridge State Forest has approximately 100 primitive campsites distributed throughout the forest. Each site has a picnic table and fire ring ... Three group sites are available.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Designated primitive campsites scattered through the forest on ridges and hollows; many sit near the Potomac River, Fifteen Mile Creek and other stream corridors. As of October 2026 DNR warns that 'Some roads and campsites may be temporarily closed following a recent flood event. Contact headquarters for current conditions.' --Claude
summary: Read DNR's Green Ridge recreation page, forest page and visitor guide: ~100 primitive designated sites (picnic table, fire ring) + 3 group sites, first-come with registration at HQ or the self-registration kiosk (cash/check), $10 standard / $20 group; phone 301-478-3124 matches. DNR says nothing about RV size or which sites a 23-ft rig can reach, and says 'Four-wheel drive may be required depending on conditions' (flagged). Note rewritten: dropped the registration line (now booking) and 'not specifically on a water body' (DNR: many sites near the Potomac and Fifteen Mile Creek); added DNR's dated flood-closure warning.
flags: CRITERIA (4WD): DNR's Green Ridge recreation page says 'Roads leading to campsites are gravel or dirt. Four-wheel drive may be required depending on conditions.' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/Greenridge/recreation-trails.aspx). Under AWH's 2026-10-21 rule (a stated 4WD requirement or recommendation drops the site), this conditional statement covers the forest's campsites as a whole; DNR does not name any sites reachable without it, and gives no RV or length guidance for any site. Decide whether the entry stays.

Website dead: the entry's website (https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/pages/publiclands/greenridge/recreation-camping.aspx) now returns 404 'File Not Found'. DNR's current pages: https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/Greenridge/recreation-trails.aspx (camping section) and https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/western_greenridgeforest.aspx.

Waterfront re-audit lead: DNR says 'Many sites are located near the Potomac River, Fifteen Mile Creek, and other stream corridors' (recreation-trails.aspx); the entry is 'not waterfront'. The entry is pinned at headquarters, so any water value would depend on which sites it represents.
